title: Among customers who paid in EUR, find those in the KAM segment whose total
question: Among customers who paid in EUR, find those in the KAM segment whose total consumption in 2013 exceeded 50,000. For these customers, calculate the average transaction price (Price) from their transactions.

prediction.sql:
SELECT AVG(t."XCL_018") AS average_transaction_price
FROM transactions_1k AS t
INNER JOIN customers AS c ON t."XCL_013" = c."XCL_001"
WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
  AND c."XCL_002" = 'KAM'
  AND t."XCL_013" IN (
    SELECT t2."XCL_013"
    FROM transactions_1k AS t2
    INNER JOIN customers AS c2 ON t2."XCL_013" = c2."XCL_001"
    WHERE c2."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
      AND c2."XCL_002" = 'KAM'
      AND t2."XCL_011" LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY t2."XCL_013"
    HAVING SUM(t2."XCL_018") > 50000
  )

SELECT AVG(t."XCL_018") AS average_transaction_price
FROM transactions_1k AS t
INNER JOIN customers AS c ON t."XCL_013" = c."XCL_001"
WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
  AND c."XCL_002" = 'KAM'
  AND t."XCL_013" IN (
    SELECT t2."XCL_013"
    FROM transactions_1k AS t2
    INNER JOIN customers AS c2 ON t2."XCL_013" = c2."XCL_001"
    WHERE c2."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
      AND c2."XCL_002" = 'KAM'
      AND t2."XCL_011" LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY t2."XCL_013"
    HAVING SUM(t2."XCL_018") > 50000
  )
